verdict.rationale: Pinecone's security docs describe API key permission management in the console and role-based access controls over resources, with service accounts and SSO listed among its production security features. Nothing in the evidence shows scoping permissions to an individual index or namespace, which is the 'per-collection' part of the story. Missing for 10: documented per-index/per-namespace permission scoping, detail on which roles exist and which operations each role governs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can enforce granular access control (API keys, roles, per-collection permissions) on database operations

citations.quote: You can manage API key permissions in the Pinecone console... Pinecone uses role-based access controls (RBAC) to manage access to resources.
